definitions.explanation: A killing treated as a criminal incident — the standard term in news reports, police statements, and crime fiction. Refers to the case or incident, not to the act in the abstract.

examples.japanese: {殺人|さつじん}{事件|じけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{殺人|さつじん}{事件|じけん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The police began investigating it as a murder case.

examples.japanese: {三十年|さんじゅうねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殺人|さつじん}{事件|じけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧ようやく⟦{解決|かいけつ}した→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: A murder case from thirty years ago was finally solved thanks to new evidence.

notes:
News style uses ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ for crimes and ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ for accidents, so the choice of word already tells listeners that a crime is suspected.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {殺人|さつじん}{事件|じけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a murder occurs
- {殺人|さつじん}{事件|じけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to investigate a murder case
- {殺人|さつじん}{事件|じけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧: a suspect in a murder case
- ⟦{未解決|みかいけつ}→未解決：17292_mikaiketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{殺人|さつじん}{事件|じけん}: an unsolved murder case

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧: murder, homicide — the act or the crime itself, without the "case" framing
- ⟦{殺人|さつじん}{未遂|みすい}→殺人未遂：17491_satsujinmisui⟧: attempted murder — where the victim survives
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: incident, case — the general word for a criminal or newsworthy occurrence
